# CRE8

> CRE8 (cre8.finance) is an app on BNB Chain for buying baskets of tokenized US stocks and crypto with USDT, held in your own smart account, with yield strategies that put your bStock to work. Portfolios rebalance automatically. CRE8 is on BNB Chain testnet: test USDT is free and signing in needs an invite code. 简体中文: https://cre8.finance/zh

## Key pages
- [How it works](https://cre8.finance/how-it-works): buying, custody, fees, selling and withdrawing, US market hours, idle-cash yield, testnet status.
- [Compare](https://cre8.finance/compare): ways to buy US stocks with USDT: an exchange, stock tokens bought yourself, a US broker, and CRE8.
- [All portfolios](https://cre8.finance/portfolios): 21 portfolios with holdings, weights and model APY.
- 中文：[首页](https://cre8.finance/zh)、[怎么运作](https://cre8.finance/zh/how-it-works)、[对比](https://cre8.finance/zh/compare)、[全部组合](https://cre8.finance/zh/portfolios)

## Key facts
- Pay with USDT. Minimum 50 USDT per purchase.
- Custody: each user has their own smart account on BNB Chain. CRE8's automation can only trade inside it; withdrawals need the owner's signature.
- Stocks are held as bStock, Binance's tokenized US stocks on BNB Chain. Stock tokens trade only during US market hours; orders placed while the market is closed wait for the next open.
- Rebalancing: monthly, plus whenever an asset drifts more than 5 points from its target weight.
- Fees: none on testnet (CRE8 pays gas). Mainnet fees will be announced before launch.
- Earn: idle USDT can go into allowlisted USDT vaults (Lista, Venus, Aave) at market rates and be withdrawn any time. When buying a portfolio, users can opt in to a yield strategy that uses the portfolio's shares; if prices fall to the safety line the system repays part of the loan automatically, without selling the shares. Cash and each portfolio's money are always kept separate. Testnet rates are simulated.
- Model APY is a backtest of current weights on historical prices, not a track record.
- Status: testnet only, no real money. No mainnet date yet.
- Availability: anyone outside the US, where local rules allow.
- Not related to the CRE8 Finance project on Solana or to any CRE8 token. CRE8 has no token at present.
